text:
Ishan R: FYI the publish guard tripped on a tiny gen diff from the OpenAPI -> types pipeline when landing the sample-sdk changes. CI shows a regen diff but it's just union/property reorder noise.

Mira V: is this the same ordering flake we've seen before? paste the diff snippet please.

Ishan R: sure — from packages/sdk/src/types/thing.ts:
```diff
- export type Mode = "alpha" | "beta";
+ export type Mode = "beta" | "alpha";
```
No semantic change.

BuildBot: regen-check failed on runner ubuntu-22.04-4; detected diff in packages/sdk/src/types/thing.ts; publishflow: blocked

Casey L: we should avoid string-based snapshots in sample-app tests. Those tests coupled to text ordering are making harmless diffs look breaking.

Mira V: Agreed. Two parallel fixes: 1) make the typegen output deterministic (stable sort pass) so generated files are canonical, 2) make sample-app tests compare parsed structures (object shape) instead of raw file text. Short-term we can allow a manual override if a follow-up ticket is created.

Ishan R: also noticed an unrelated auth/retry flake in the CI matrix: one job returned 401 without retry. Reproduced locally when running tests under a docker matrix variant — looks like the test harness sets AUTH_RETRIES after the module is required.

Casey L: that explains it. Tests that read env at import time are brittle across runner setups. Let's set env vars before require or make the auth module read defaults from a helper that can be stubbed in tests.

Mira V: plan: PR-1 change sample-app snapshots to JSON-parse and compare by keys/sets (non-order-sensitive). PR-2 add stable-sort to typegen postprocess and a CI unit that runs generator in a docker image to assert deterministic output. PR-3 fix test harness so AUTH_RETRIES is applied before requiring auth module.

Ishan R: I'll open PR-1 and PR-3 first so we can get the publishflow unblocked. PR-2 can land as a small patch but we should get it green before next minor release.

BuildBot: publishflow guard: blocked -> awaiting human review. Related issues: DEVX-1201 (typegen-order), DEVX-1202 (snapshot-order-dep), DEVX-1203 (auth-env-race)

Casey L: small note on semver: our changelog bot currently treats any typegen diff as a potential minor due to surface change heuristics. We should teach it to run an AST-level comparator that ignores union/property order and only flags real shape changes.

Mira V: +1. I'll file a follow-up ticket for changelog-gen to include an AST comparator and add a short DevEx doc explaining what counts as a breaking/api change for autogenerated types.

Ishan R: ETA: will open PRs within the hour and ping #release. If someone oncall can manually override once PR-1/3 merged and open DEVX-1204 for changelog work, we can proceed.

Casey L: thanks. action items assigned: Ishan (PR-1, PR-3), Mira (changelog ticket + doc), Casey (PR-2 stable sort draft).

docs-bot: created ticket DEVX-1204: "changelog: ignore order-only typegen diffs via AST comparator"

Mira V: great, will follow up after merges and close the loop. :thumbsup:
